title: The World's Richest Person
subtitle: Net worth rankings from 1987 to 2022
hook: See how the title of the world's richest person changed over time.
setup: This data race visualizes the shifts in estimated net worth among top global figures.

highlights.headline: Carlos Slim takes lead
